bio.text: Travis Jack Stevens is a declared write-in candidate for U.S. Senate in Delaware in 2026, and the Delaware Department of Elections lists his write-in candidacy as qualified.
According to his campaign website, he has been a registered nurse since 2012, worked as a travel ICU nurse, and served on COVID-19 front lines.
His campaign site says he founded the CAMP Rehoboth Cares Committee and is a former secretary of the Eastern Sussex Democrats.
